claim: Exact ordered-integer point and Vieta-component censuses in the height-10000 box for x^2+y^2+z^2=3xyz+k, k=0,1,2.

correctness_evidence.method: fresh exact Vieta floods from the stated roots with equation and box assertions, plus independent review of the descent completeness argument

literature.title: The birational geometry of Markov numbers
literature.coverage: Classical k=0 Markoff structure; no combined bounded census.

literature.authors: David Alfaya; Luis Angel Calvo; Pedro-Jose Cazorla; Javier Rodrigo; Anitha Srinivasan
literature.title: Branches of Markoff m-triples with two k-Fibonacci components
literature.coverage: Structural special-branch results for generalized Markoff m-triples; no audited height-10000 census for m=1,2 found.

value_reason: The contribution is an arbitrary bounded census of 839 points and does not resolve uniqueness, classify generalized orbits unboundedly, prove a new asymptotic, or provide a reusable structural theorem beyond standard Vieta descent.
repair: Narrowing to the k=2 census and deepest branch still leaves a finite cutoff computation without an unbounded structural result.
